definitions.explanation: Taking in and housing people or things in a facility. Also refers to the capacity of a venue.
Confining people in a facility, such as a detention center or internment camp.

notes:
{収容|しゅうよう} has two distinct senses with different connotations: sense 1 (capacity/shelter) is neutral, while sense 2 (detention/internment) carries a negative connotation of forced confinement.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: [people/things]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収容|しゅうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

SENSE 1 — CAPACITY/SHELTER:
- {収容|しゅうよう}⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧: seating/accommodation capacity
- {収容|しゅうよう}{能力|のうりょく}: capacity, ability to hold
- 500⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧{収容|しゅうよう}: holds 500 people
- {避難者|ひなんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収容|しゅうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shelter evacuees

SENSE 2 — DETENTION/INTERNMENT:
- ⟦{収容所|しゅうようじょ}→収容所：22753_shuuyoujo⟧: detention/internment camp
- {収容|しゅうよう}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: detention facility
- ⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧{収容|しゅうよう}: forced internment

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in news, legal, and administrative contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ or ⟦{泊|と}める→泊める：13281_tomeru⟧ would be more natural for sense 1.
